summary: Requested the execution that closes the gap the current Q2 account still lists: the same application-applied removal when the reduced configuration still has two voters and only PreVote is enabled. The new harness (assurance_two_voter_prevote_test.go) elects node 1 in {1,2,3}, applies the committed removal of node 1 on all three nodes, lets node 2 lead {2,3} and commit an entry the removed leader never sees, then delivers the read to node 1 and observes the request's fate. Built against the captured source and run in a clean copy of the module containing only that file, its sequence is: the singleton shortcut cannot apply (voters=(2 3), singleton false), so the removed leader takes the request into readOnly.unconfirmedReads and broadcasts two heartbeats with no answer; one heartbeat tick later it learns of the new term and leaves the leader state; and the accepted request is then gone - no read state, no unconfirmed or pending request, and no refusal handed to the caller, so the outcome is neither a current index nor a refusal, and the caller's only recourse is its own retry deadline. The five comparisons are the three premises, the one-tick bound, and that witness (read_answered eq true, expected violated), so the receipt also records the safety half (no stale answer was handed out). Validation reports valid with an experiment created.
